title: Practice 4: Dative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Неоднозначные фразы в целом ведут к ___ (забавный) интерпретациям.
exercises.prompt: Ambiguous phrases in general lead to amusing interpretations.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «интерпретациям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Skateboarding on cobblestone can be dangerous.
exercises.ru: Кататься по ___ мостовой на скейте может быть опасно.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «мостовой»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Инфракрасные лучи относятся к ___ (электромагнитный) излучению.
exercises.prompt: An infrared ray is electromagnetic radiation.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «излучению»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He was selling it at an outrageous price.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «цене»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Земельная реформа привела к ___ (больший) переменам в жизни людей.
exercises.prompt: Land reform caused a great change in the lives of the people.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «переменам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Some reptiles molt to adapt to seasonal temperature changes.
exercises.ru: Некоторые рептилии линяют, чтобы приспособиться к ___ изменениям температуры.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «изменениям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Какой сегодня день по ___ (юлианский) календарю?
exercises.prompt: What day is it today on the Julian calendar?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «календарю»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
exercises.ru: Эта школа предъявляет высокие требования к ___ облику учеников.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «облику»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Терпимость — это хорошо. Только не по отношению к ___ (нетерпимый) людям.
exercises.prompt: Tolerance is good. Just not towards intolerant people.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «людям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «тоннелю»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (необъяснимый) причине эта хлипкая лачуга пережила шторм.
exercises.prompt: For some inexplicable reason, the flimsy shack survived the storm.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «причине»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Magdalena and Lech are preparing for their Polish exams.
exercises.ru: Магдалена и Лех готовятся к экзамену по ___ языку.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «языку»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Эта доктрина несомненно приведёт к ___ (печальный) последствиям.
exercises.prompt: That doctrine will no doubt lead to dismal consequences.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «последствиям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Guide dogs help blind people.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «людям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У меня перевес по ___ (ручной) клади.
exercises.prompt: My carry-on luggage is over the allowed weight.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «клади»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I did it for a good reason.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «причине»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я сделал это по ___ (собственный) почину.
exercises.prompt: I did it of my own free will.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «почину»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: At your service, madam!
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «услугам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Глобализация привела к ___ (круглосуточный) торговле.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «торговле»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm not forcing you to pay extra.
exercises.ru: Я не обязываю вас к ___ платежу.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «платежу»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
